title: A Network client site's badge or removal refreshes the client's live website

source.ref: Space function scan 2026-11-17 (project thread: Trace every Space feature end to end)

detail: toggleClientSiteBadge and removeClientSite (which drops the client Space to free, so its custom domain stops being eligible) change the client Space and revalidate only the Network's settings page. They never call refreshSite(client slug), so the hosted site keeps the old badge and domain state until its cache expires (about 10 minutes). Done 2026-11-17: both actions now call refreshSite with the client Space's slug after a successful change (a rolled-back removal or refused badge change refreshes nothing), so the live site shows the new badge and domain state on the next request. The refresh is best-effort and never fails a change that already saved and billed.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
